title: HR portal: confirm your bank details for pay
scenario: An email styled like your HR system says your payroll bank details need re-confirmation before this month's pay run, with a link to a form that asks for your account and routing numbers.

answers.A: Log into your real HR/payroll system directly instead of using the emailed link.
answers.B: Fill in the form, and also update it again when a follow-up email asks.
answers.C: Fill in the form through the link to make sure you're paid on time.

explanation: Payroll bank-detail changes are one of the most common employee-targeted business email compromises, because a missed paycheck is a powerful, personal pressure point.
proTip: Pay details are updated inside the payroll system you already use, not through an emailed form.
